entries.03391bec5e543ed5: Advertising production companies and design production companies
entries.06cefbdf4d378202: This is a storefront-based making experience business operated by consolidated subsidiary YASUMI WORKS. It became a subsidiary in October 2025. Revenue for each business alone is not disclosed.
entries.1239548856a018db: A company that operates "PIXTA", an online marketplace for digital materials such as photos, illustrations and videos, and "fotowa", an on-location photography platform.
entries.1d5d083d0505a63f: This is a corporate photography business. PIXTA Custom is a production service for original stock photos, launched in September 2023. Revenue for each business alone is not disclosed.
entries.2355def71350562a: Corporations and individuals that use digital materials in large volumes and frequently
entries.542679aed91923ed: Publishing and printing companies, and other companies and organizations
entries.8195c0315524dc31: This is a sales scheme that allows purchase of digital materials one item at a time as needed. Revenue from each scheme alone is not disclosed.
entries.85ab929104f04820: This is a reportable segment that operates fotowa (Fotowa), an on-site photography platform for family and children's portraits. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥502 million. For newborn photography, Shichi-Go-San and other children's milestones and events, users can book a preferred photographer by specifying time and location and have family commemorative photos taken. Following a change in the terms of use in December 2024, the contract form changed from a matching service (intermediary contract) to a self-provided service (contracting), and revenue recognition changed from net to gross.
entries.a39b4555de8c5449: This is a business segment not included in the reportable segments.
entries.a420f4eb5f8a0c1f: Corporations and individuals that need digital materials
entries.ae67b7771776a95f: This is a sales scheme that allows materials to be downloaded up to a set number for a flat fee during the contract period. Flat-rate subscription revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,268 million.
entries.cd6dccaea77ab478: This is a reportable segment that operates PIXTA, an online marketplace for digital content such as photos, illustrations, videos, and music. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,001 million. Materials are collected from creators in Japan and abroad in a crowdsourcing format, and all are sold to corporations and individuals under royalty-free licenses. When materials are sold, creators are granted acquired credits according to the sales price and commission rate.
entries.d53275515b7e50c0: Individuals who wish to have family photos taken
entries.e03c01e44a627b34: This is a business segment not included in the reportable segments. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥159 million. It includes PIXTA On-Demand and PIXTA Custom, corporate photography businesses, and the storefront-based making experience business and others operated by consolidated subsidiary YASUMI WORKS.
